note: Selection reads fixed-endpoint pooled total-delta norms only; no task score, geometry, drift or probe outcome was consulted. A failed_match task retains its nearest coefficient and must be reported as a failed match, not asserted as norm-matched.

rule.allowed_selection_inputs: validated fixed-step norms only, with every per-module norm retained
rule.expansion: separate pre-outcome decision required; at most two both-outer-boundary rounds by factor 10
rule.failed_match: retain all tried coefficients, failures and nearest coefficient; do not assert a matched effect
rule.selection: smallest absolute relative norm error; lower coefficient breaks exact ties
rule.target: P1_MIX coefficient 0.001 at the fixed endpoint on seed 31415
